_comment: BloodDebt is a printed keyword (in printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field - not authored here. GAP: The banish clause should let the CONTROLLER choose up to 2 cards from opponent's graveyard, but BANISH effect asks the zone owner (opponent) to choose. LOOK_AT does not support GRAVEYARD zone (zone_map only has DECK_TOP/ARSENAL/HAND), so the triage's LOOK_AT->SELECT_FROM_REF->BANISH_REF composition is not currently expressible. Authored with BANISH as best approximation; the chooser deviation is a known DSL limitation (also noted on gravekeeping_* cards). REF_CONTAINS_TYPE correctly checks the set of banished cards for both an attack action card (types Action+Attack) and a non-attack action card (types Action, not_types Attack).
